issue.title: test_owner_cleanup_stops_monitor_child_and_suppresses_followup sees the monitor child still running under -n 8

task_type_fields.evidence:
Proposed by phase sase-1nn.6 (note #4, epic sase-1nn "Green master's release gates and ship sase v0.18.1") and triaged by the sase-1nn land agent on 2026-10-23.

While proving its own fixes, sase-1nn.6 ran `tests/monitor/` under `-n 8` on master around 1a3a7022d1/bdec291c77. This node failed once with `assert not is_process_running(...)`: the monitor child was still alive when the assertion ran after owner cleanup. The node passed on the phase's other `-n 8` runs of the same files and has not been seen in Master Gate or Full CI. Fail rate is about 1 in 4 local parallel runs, and it was never reproduced serially. Hypothesis: the test checks process liveness right after cleanup sends its signal, without waiting for the child to be reaped, so a loaded host can still see it as running. The sase-1nn epic did not touch `src/sase/monitor` or this test.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by phase sase-1nn.6 as an intermittent tests/monitor failure seen while proving unrelated fixes; no existing bead tracks this node.

payload.entry: CORRECTION to the evidence field: the 'about 1 in 4 local parallel runs' fail rate is not measured. The only observation is sase-1nn.6 note #4: one failure under tests/monitor/ -n 8, after which its later -n 8 runs on the diagnostics files passed. The real fail rate is unknown and the failure was never run serially. Measure it before choosing a fix.
